ichigo.name: Ichigo Kurosaki
ichigo.description: Substitute Soul Reaper with Shinigami, Quincy, Hollow, and Fullbring powers.

isshin.name: Isshin Kurosaki
isshin.description: Former Captain of Squad 10 and former head of the Shiba Clan.

masaki.name: Masaki Kurosaki
masaki.description: Last of the Kurosaki pure-blood Quincy line. Mother of Ichigo, Karin, and Yuzu.

karin.name: Karin Kurosaki
karin.description: Ichigo's younger sister. Possesses latent spiritual awareness.

yuzu.name: Yuzu Kurosaki
yuzu.description: Ichigo's youngest sister. Kind and domestic.

kaien.name: Kaien Shiba
kaien.description: Former Lieutenant of Squad 13. Mentor to Rukia Kuchiki.

kukaku.name: Kukaku Shiba
kukaku.description: Self-proclaimed fireworks master of the Shiba Clan.

ganju.name: Ganju Shiba
ganju.description: Youngest Shiba sibling. Skilled in earth-based kidō.

byakuya.name: Byakuya Kuchiki
byakuya.description: 28th Head of the Kuchiki Clan and Captain of Squad 6.

rukia.name: Rukia Kuchiki
rukia.description: Adopted into the Kuchiki Clan. Captain of Squad 13.

hisana.name: Hisana Kuchiki
hisana.description: Byakuya's late wife and Rukia's biological elder sister.

ichibei.name: Ichibē Hyōsube
ichibei.description: Monk Who Calls the Real Name. Leader of the Zero Division.

senjumaru.name: Senjumaru Shutara
senjumaru.description: The Great Weave Guard. Creates the Ōken garments.

kirio.name: Kirio Hikifune
kirio.description: The Ruler of Grain. Inventor of the artificial soul.

tenjiro.name: Tenjirō Kirinji
tenjiro.description: The Hot Spring Demon. Creator of healing hot springs.

oetsu.name: Ōetsu Nimaiya
oetsu.description: The God of the Sword. Creator of the Zanpakutō.

yhwach.name: Yhwach
yhwach.description: Father of all Quincy. Son of the Soul King. Possessed The Almighty.

ryuken.name: Ryūken Ishida
ryuken.description: Last Quincy standing according to himself.

orihime.name: Orihime Inoue
orihime.description: Possesses Shun Shun Rikka. Married to Ichigo.

chad.name: Yasutora Sado
chad.description: Ichigo's close friend. Possesses Fullbring arms.

kanae.name: Kanae Katagiri
kanae.description: Gemischt Quincy, maid of the Ishida family, wife of Ryuken.

izumi.name: Izumi Ishida
izumi.description: Wife of Soken Ishida and mother of Ryuken.

urahara.name: Kisuke Urahara
urahara.description: Former Squad 12 Captain, founder of the SRDI, currently shop owner.

yoruichi.name: Yoruichi Shihoin
yoruichi.description: Former 22nd Head of the Shihoin Clan, former Squad 2 Captain.

tessai.name: Tessai Tsukabishi
tessai.description: Former Captain of the Kido Corps.

ginjo.name: Kugo Ginjo
ginjo.description: First Substitute Soul Reaper and leader of Xcution.

tsukishima.name: Shukuro Tsukishima
tsukishima.description: Former leader of Xcution, wields Book of the End.

tatsuki.name: Tatsuki Arisawa
tatsuki.description: Orihime's best friend and martial artist.

chizuru.name: Chizuru Honsho
chizuru.description: Classmate with a huge crush on Orihime.

ikumi.name: Ikumi Unagiya
ikumi.description: Owner of Unagiya Shop, Ichigo's boss.

hiyori.name: Hiyori Sarugaki
hiyori.description: Former Lieutenant of Squad 12, hot-tempered Visored.

aizen.name: Sosuke Aizen
aizen.description: Supreme Lord of Las Noches and former Captain of Squad 5. Masterminded the Arrancar army using the Hōgyoku to transcend Shinigami and Hollow boundaries.
aizen.affiliations: Las Noches Ruler · Former Squad 5 Captain

kon.name: Kon
kon.description: Modified Soul placed in a stuffed lion.

kenpachi.name: Kenpachi Zaraki
kenpachi.description: 11th Captain of Squad 11. Feared throughout Soul Society for his monstrous spiritual pressure, love of battle, and immense endurance.

unohana.name: Retsu Unohana
unohana.description: Captain of Squad 4, supreme healer of Soul Society, and secretly Yachiru Unohana, the legendary First Kenpachi.

soi_fon.name: Soi Fon
soi_fon.description: Captain of Squad 2 and Commander-in-Chief of the Onmitsukido. Master of Hakuda and Shunpo.

yammy.name: Yammy Llargo
yammy.description: Cero (0) and Decima (10) Espada representing Rage. Releases into a colossal behemoth with Ira.

starrk.name: Coyote Starrk
starrk.description: Primera (1st) Espada representing Solitude. Soul naturally split with Lilynette due to immense loneliness; wields Los Lobos.

lilynette.name: Lilynette Gingerbuck
lilynette.description: The other half of Coyote Starrk's split soul and his sole Fracción. Fuses into Starrk's twin pistols upon Resurrección.

baraggan.name: Baraggan Louisenbairn
baraggan.description: Segunda (2nd) Espada representing Aging (Senescence). Former King and God of Hueco Mundo before being subjugated by Aizen; wields Arrogante.
baraggan.affiliations: Espada · Las Noches · Hueco Mundo Royalty

harribel.name: Tier Harribel
harribel.description: Tercera (3rd) Espada representing Sacrifice. Calm water-manipulator wielding Tiburón; later ascends as Queen and Ruler of Hueco Mundo.

nelliel.name: Nelliel Tu Odelschwanck
nelliel.description: Former Tercera (3rd) Espada. Betrayed and wounded by Nnoitra and Szayelaporro; transformed into child Nel before regaining Gamuza form.

ulquiorra.name: Ulquiorra Cifer
ulquiorra.description: Cuarta (4th) Espada representing Emptiness. Cold, calculating warrior wielding Murciélago with exclusive Segunda Etapa form; Ichigo's fateful rival.

nnoitra.name: Nnoitra Gilga
nnoitra.description: Quinta (5th) Espada representing Despair. Possesses the hardest Hierro in Las Noches; wields six-scythe Santa Teresa and seeks death in battle.

grimmjow.name: Grimmjow Jaegerjaquez
grimmjow.description: Sexta (6th) Espada representing Destruction. Fierce predator wielding Pantera; Ichigo's eternal rival who later aids the Soul Society in TYBW.

luppi.name: Luppi Antenor
luppi.description: Temporary Sexta (6th) Espada while Grimmjow was demoted. Wields eight-tentacled Trepadora before being annihilated upon Grimmjow's restoration.
luppi.affiliations: Espada · Las Noches · Mayuri's Corpse Unit

zommari.name: Zommari Rureaux
zommari.description: Séptima (7th) Espada representing Intoxication. Fastest Sonído master wielding Brujería with Amor body-puppeting sight; defeated by Byakuya.

szayelaporro.name: Szayelaporro Granz
szayelaporro.description: Octava (8th) Espada representing Madness. Chief scientist of Las Noches wielding Fornicarás with cloning, organ-crushing dolls, and rebirth abilities.

aaroniero.name: Aaroniero Arruruerie
aaroniero.description: Novena (9th) Espada representing Greed. Sole surviving Gillian-class Espada of the first generation; absorbed 33,650 Hollows including Kaien Shiba via Glotonería.
aaroniero.affiliations: Espada · Las Noches · Shiba Clan Echo

dordoni.name: Dordoni Alessandro Del Socaccio
dordoni.description: Privaron Espada #103 (Tres Cifras). Former Espada wielding cyclone-generating Giralda; pushed Ichigo to use Bankai and Hollowfication with chivalry.
dordoni.affiliations: Privaron Espada · Las Noches · Mayuri's Corpse Unit

cirucci.name: Cirucci Sanderwicci
cirucci.description: Privaron Espada #105. Former Espada wielding bladed whip Golondrina; fought Uryū Ishida before later being reanimated by Mayuri Kurotsuchi.
cirucci.affiliations: Privaron Espada · Las Noches · Mayuri's Corpse Unit

gantenbainne.name: Gantenbainne Mosqueda
gantenbainne.description: Privaron Espada #107. Afro-styled pugilist wielding gauntlet Dragra; engaged Chad in an honorable fist fight and was healed by Unohana.

shawlong.name: Shawlong Qufang
shawlong.description: Arrancar #11 and intellectual leader of Grimmjow's Fracción. Wields clawed Resurrección Tijereta; analyzed Tōshirō Hitsugaya in Karakura Town.

edrad.name: Edrad Liones
edrad.description: Arrancar #13 in Grimmjow's Fracción. Flame-wielding brawler possessing volcanic Volcánica; pushed Ikkaku Madarame to reveal Bankai.

ylfordt.name: Ilforte Granz
ylfordt.description: Arrancar #15 in Grimmjow's Fracción and elder brother of Szayelaporro Granz. Wields horned bull Resurrección Del Toro against Renji Abarai.
ylfordt.affiliations: Grimmjow's Fracción · Granz Family · Las Noches

diroy.name: D-Roy Linker
diroy.description: Arrancar #16 in Grimmjow's Fracción. Incomplete Arrancar defeated in Karakura Town by Rukia Kuchiki with Sode no Shirayuki.

nakim.name: Nakeem Grindina
nakim.description: Arrancar #14 in Grimmjow's Fracción. Silent, hulking warrior who fought Rangiku Matsumoto in Karakura Town.

apacci.name: Emilou Apacci
apacci.description: Arrancar #54 and member of Harribel's Tres Bestias. Fierce, hot-headed deer Arrancar wielding Cierva; summons Ayon.
apacci.affiliations: Tres Bestias · Harribel's Fracción · Las Noches

milarose.name: Franceska Mila Rose
milarose.description: Arrancar #55 and member of Harribel's Tres Bestias. Amazonian warrior wielding lion-themed Leona; fuses her left arm to summon Ayon.
milarose.affiliations: Tres Bestias · Harribel's Fracción · Las Noches

sunsun.name: Cyan Sung-Sun
sunsun.description: Arrancar #56 and member of Harribel's Tres Bestias. Composed serpent Arrancar wielding Anaconda and Muda illusion barriers; summons Ayon.
sunsun.affiliations: Tres Bestias · Harribel's Fracción · Las Noches

ayon.name: Ayon
ayon.description: Terrifying chimera beast created through Quimera Parca when Apacci, Mila Rose, and Sung-Sun sacrifice their left arms in battle.
ayon.affiliations: Tres Bestias Summon · Hueco Mundo Creature

charlotte.name: Charlotte Chuhlhourne
charlotte.description: Arrancar #20 and Baraggan's Fracción. Flamboyant aesthetician wielding Reina De Rosas; engaged Yumichika in Fake Karakura Town.
charlotte.affiliations: Baraggan's Fracción · Las Noches · Mayuri's Corpse Unit

abirama.name: Abirama Redder
abirama.description: Arrancar #22 and Baraggan's Fracción. Ferocious aerial berserker wielding hawk-themed Águila; fought Izuru Kira.

findorr.name: Findorr Calius
findorr.description: Arrancar #24 and Baraggan's Fracción. Analytical warrior wielding Pinza Aguda who breaks his mask to elevate his power to Captain level; fought Hisagi.

poww.name: Choe Neng Poww
poww.description: Arrancar #25 and Baraggan's Fracción. Mammoth brute who crushed the Karakura Town pillars and defeated Ikkaku before being slain by Komamura.

ggio.name: Ggio Vega
ggio.description: Arrancar #26 and Baraggan's Fracción. Agile martial artist wielding sabertooth Tigre Estoque; engaged Soi-Fon in deadly close combat.

nirgge.name: Nirgge Parduoc
nirgge.description: Arrancar #27 and Baraggan's Fracción. Heavy elephant Arrancar wielding Mamut; fought Marechiyo Ōmaeda.

tesla.name: Tesla Lindocruz
tesla.description: Arrancar #50 and Nnoitra's deeply devoted Fracción. Wields spiked warthog Verruga and shielded his master until the bitter end.

pesche.name: Pesche Guatiche
pesche.description: Former Fracción of Nelliel. Loyal guardian masked as comic relief, master of slick Infinite Slick fluids and Ultima Cero alongside Dondochakka.
pesche.affiliations: Nel's Group · Hueco Mundo Wandering Trio

dondochakka.name: Dondochakka Birstanne
dondochakka.description: Former Fracción of Nelliel. Gentle giant who houses insectoid Hollow allies inside his stomach and wields devastating Sincrónico Cero attacks.
dondochakka.affiliations: Nel's Group · Hueco Mundo Wandering Trio

bawabawa.name: Bawabawa
bawabawa.description: Giant sand-burrowing eel Hollow companion who acts as loyal pet and desert transport for Nel, Pesche, and Dondochakka.
bawabawa.affiliations: Nel's Group · Hueco Mundo Desert Beast

lumina.name: Lumina
lumina.description: Szayelaporro's tiny, devoted Fracción created through genetic modification. Eaten by Szayelaporro to instantly regenerate mortal wounds.

medazeppi.name: Medazeppi
medazeppi.description: Colossal, long-necked Fracción of Szayelaporro Granz, slain by Renji Abarai's Zabimaru in the Las Noches laboratory corridors.

wonderweiss.name: Wonderweiss Margela
wonderweiss.description: Arrancar #77 and sole Modified Arrancar forged directly by the Hōgyoku. Sacrificed higher speech to seal Genryūsai Yamamoto's Ryūjin Jakka flames.
wonderweiss.affiliations: Aizen's Secret Weapon · Las Noches Special Unit

rudbornn.name: Rudbornn Chelute
rudbornn.description: Arrancar #61 and Captain of the Exequias execution squad. Wields skull-blossom Árbol, generating endless skull soldier armies from his branches.
rudbornn.affiliations: Exequias Commander · Las Noches Military Police

loly.name: Loly Aivirrne
loly.description: Arrancar #33 and attendant of Aizen. Jealous rival of Orihime Inoue wielding venomous centipede Escolopendra.

menoly.name: Menoly Mallia
menoly.description: Arrancar #34 and companion of Loly Aivirrne. More cautious attendant of Aizen who recognized the terrifying aura of Ichigo and Ulquiorra.

aisslinger.name: Aisslinger Wernarr
aisslinger.description: Avian-masked Arrancar gatekeeper of Hueco Mundo. Wields projectile feathers Uña Tiroreador; fought Chad and Ishida in the desert threshold.

demoura.name: Demoura Zodd
demoura.description: Giant brawny Arrancar gatekeeper stationed at the underground gateway of Hueco Mundo with Aisslinger; defeated by Yasutora Sado.

aldegor.name: Aldegor
aldegor.description: Armored boar Arrancar warrior wielding Jabarí; sent on scouting and reconnaissance missions through the Hueco Mundo borderlands.

kukkapuro.name: Kukkapūro
kukkapuro.description: Arrancar #35 and tiny dog-like Hollow. Uniquely spared and cherished by Yammy Llargo as his gentle, bark-happy desert pet companion.

gin.name: Gin Ichimaru
gin.description: Former Captain of Squad 3 who defected with Aizen to Las Noches. Maintained an enigmatic viper smile while secretly plotting to kill Aizen for Rangiku.
gin.affiliations: Las Noches Command · Former Gotei 13 Captain

tosen.name: Kaname Tōsen
tosen.description: Former Captain of Squad 9 and supreme commander of the Arrancar army. Sought path of least bloodshed; attained Hollowfication and Grillar Grillo Resurrección.
tosen.affiliations: Las Noches General · Former Gotei 13 Captain

renji.name: Renji Abarai
renji.description: Lieutenant of Squad 6. Fierce warrior wielding Zabimaru and husband of Rukia Kuchiki.

hitsugaya.name: Tōshirō Hitsugaya
hitsugaya.description: Prodigious Captain of Squad 10 wielding Hyōrinmaru, the strongest ice-element Zanpakutō.

shunsui.name: Shunsui Kyōraku
shunsui.description: Captain of Squad 8 and later Captain-Commander of the Gotei 13. Wields dual blades Katen Kyōkotsu.

grand_fisher.name: Grand Fisher
grand_fisher.description: Infamous Hollow who evaded Soul Reapers for 50 years and killed Masaki Kurosaki using a human girl lure. Later transformed into an imperfect Arrancar by Aizen and bifurcated by Isshin Kurosaki.

yamamoto.name: Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto
yamamoto.description: Legendary founder and supreme Captain-Commander of the Gotei 13 and Captain of Squad 1 for over a thousand years. Wields Ryūjin Jakka and the apocalyptic Zanka no Tachi flames.
yamamoto.affiliations: Squad 1 Captain · Gotei 13 Supreme Commander · Shinō Academy Founder

mayuri.name: Mayuri Kurotsuchi
mayuri.description: Macabre scientist and Captain of Squad 12, serving as 2nd President of the S.R.D.I. Wields poison-producing Ashisogi Jizō; views combat as a series of laboratory experiments.

ukitake.name: Jūshirō Ukitake
ukitake.description: Beloved, honorable Captain of Squad 13 and host to Mimihagi, the right hand of the Soul King. Wields twin blades Sōgyo no Kotowari capable of absorbing and reflecting attacks.

rangiku.name: Rangiku Matsumoto
rangiku.description: Free-spirited Lieutenant of Squad 10 under Tōshirō Hitsugaya. Wields ash-dissolving Haineko; childhood soulmate of Gin Ichimaru whose soul fragment was stolen by Aizen's Hōgyoku.

kira.name: Izuru Kira
kira.description: Somber Lieutenant of Squad 3. Wields hook-shaped Wabisuke, doubling the weight of anything it strikes; burdened by the dark, heavy realities of war and Gin Ichimaru's betrayal.

nanao.name: Nanao Ise
nanao.description: Composed and methodical Lieutenant of Squad 8 (later Squad 1) under Shunsui Kyōraku. Sole priestess heir to the Ise Clan capable of wielding the god-cleaving mirror sword Shinken Hakkyōken.
nanao.affiliations: Squad 8 / Squad 1 Lieutenant · Ise Clan Priestess · Gotei 13

ikkaku.name: Ikkaku Madarame
ikkaku.description: Fierce warrior and 3rd Seat (later Lieutenant) of Squad 11. Reveres Kenpachi Zaraki; secretly unlocked Bankai Ryūmon Hōzukimaru and serves as martial instructor to Renji Abarai.

yumichika.name: Yumichika Ayasegawa
yumichika.description: Aesthetic-driven 5th Seat (later 3rd Seat) of Squad 11 and lifelong brother-in-arms of Ikkaku Madarame. Disguises his energy-absorbing true Shikai Ruri'iro Kujaku to respect squad pride.

yachiru.name: Yachiru Kusajishi
yachiru.description: Playful, candy-loving Lieutenant of Squad 11 and President of the Shinigami Women's Association. Revealed as the living embodiment of Kenpachi Zaraki's Zanpakutō spirit, Nozarashi.

nemu.name: Nemu Kurotsuchi
nemu.description: Artificial Soul (Nemuri VII) and dutiful Lieutenant of Squad 12 created by Mayuri Kurotsuchi. Possesses high-density spiritual power, superhuman durability, and adaptive regenerative flesh.

hanataro.name: Hanatarō Yamada
hanataro.description: Timid yet courageous 7th Seat and leader of the 14th Advanced Relief Team in Squad 4. Guided Ichigo and Ganju through the Seireitei underground sewers; wields healing scalpel Hisagomaru.

sasakibe.name: Chōjirō Sasakibe
sasakibe.description: Loyal Lieutenant of Squad 1 who served as Yamamoto's right hand for over 2,000 years. Mastered the ancient lightning Bankai Kōkō Gonryō Rikyū before falling to the Wandenreich.

omaeda.name: Marechiyo Ōmaeda
omaeda.description: Loud and affluent Lieutenant of Squad 2 and Corps Commander of the Patrol Unit under Soi-Fon. Wields heavy spiked morning-star Zanpakutō Gegetsuburi.
omaeda.affiliations: Squad 2 Lieutenant · Onmitsukidō Patrol Commander · Noble

isane.name: Isane Kotetsu
isane.description: Devoted Lieutenant (later Captain) of Squad 4 under Retsu Unohana. Master of high-level restorative Kidō and wielder of frozen mist Zanpakutō Itegumo; elder sister of Kiyone.

kiyone.name: Kiyone Kotetsu
kiyone.description: Enthusiastic 3rd Seat of Squad 13 under Captain Ukitake and younger sister of Isane Kotetsu. Vied loudly with Sentarō to attend to their captain; later appointed Squad 4 lieutenant.

sentaro.name: Sentarō Kotsubaki
sentaro.description: Passionate, loud 3rd Seat of Squad 13 under Jūshirō Ukitake. Continually competed with Kiyone Kotetsu to demonstrate loyalty to his captain.

jidanbo.name: Jidanbō Ikkanzaka
jidanbo.description: Colossal, honorable gatekeeper of the Seireitei's West Gate (Hakuryūmon). Befriended Ichigo and the Ryoka after being honorably bested in battle.

soul_king.name: Soul King
soul_king.description: The linchpin and primordial deity of the Bleach cosmos whose existence stabilizes the Soul Society, Hueco Mundo, and the Living World. Father of Yhwach.

lille_barro.name: Lille Barro
lille_barro.description: Leader of the Schutzstaffel and Sternritter 'X' - 'The X-Axis'. The first Quincy bestowed a Vollständig and Schrift by Yhwach.

gerard_valkyrie.name: Gerard Valkyrie
gerard_valkyrie.description: Schutzstaffel warrior and Sternritter 'M' - 'The Miracle'. The physical manifestation of the Soul King's heart.

pernida_parnkgjas.name: Pernida Parnkgjas
pernida_parnkgjas.description: Schutzstaffel member and Sternritter 'C' - 'The Compulsory'. The sentient, governing left hand of the Soul King.

askin_nakk_le_vaar.name: Askin Nakk Le Vaar
askin_nakk_le_vaar.description: Eccentric Schutzstaffel elite promoted to the royal guard. Sternritter 'D' - 'The Deathdealing', manipulating lethal doses.

bambietta_basterbine.name: Bambietta Basterbine
bambietta_basterbine.description: Sternritter 'E' - 'The Explode'. Fierce de facto leader of the female Sternritter squad.

as_nodt.name: Äs Nödt
as_nodt.description: Sternritter 'F' - 'The Fear'. Inflicts primal, psychological terror through reishi thorns; stole Byakuya Kuchiki's Bankai.

liltotto_lamperd.name: Liltotto Lamperd
liltotto_lamperd.description: Sternritter 'G' - 'The Glutton'. Pragmatic, sharp-tongued member of the Bambies capable of consuming anything.

bazz_b.name: Bazz-B
bazz_b.description: Sternritter 'H' - 'The Heat'. Hot-headed flame manipulator and childhood companion turned rival of Jugram Haschwalth.

cang_du.name: Cang Du
cang_du.description: Sternritter 'I' - 'The Iron'. Martial artist clad in impenetrable iron skin; stole Tōshirō Hitsugaya's Bankai.

quilge_opie.name: Quilge Opie
quilge_opie.description: Sternritter 'J' - 'The Jail'. Executive commander of the First Jagdarmee tasked with hunting Arrancar in Hueco Mundo.

bg9.name: BG9
bg9.description: Sternritter 'K'. Armored robotic combatant wielding high-tech artillery; stole Suì-Fēng's Bankai.

pepe_waccabrada.name: PePe Waccabrada
pepe_waccabrada.description: Sternritter 'L' - 'The Love'. Enforces mind-control through hearts of love onto objects and souls.

robert_accutrone.name: Robert Accutrone
robert_accutrone.description: Sternritter 'N'. Senior veteran gunslinger who blinded Shunsui Kyōraku in one eye during the first invasion.

driscoll_berci.name: Driscoll Berci
driscoll_berci.description: Sternritter 'O' - 'The Overkill'. Ruthless brute who murdered Chōjirō Sasakibe and stole his Bankai.

meninas_mcallon.name: Meninas McAllon
meninas_mcallon.description: Sternritter 'P' - 'The Power'. Soft-spoken member of the Bambies possessing immense superhuman physical strength.

mask_de_masculine.name: Mask de Masculine
mask_de_masculine.description: Sternritter 'S' - 'The Superstar'. Lucha libre wrestler whose power skyrockets from the cheers of his partner James.

james.name: James
james.description: Mask de Masculine's loyal fan and counterpart whose cheering fuels Mask's superstar regeneration and strength.

candice_catnipp.name: Candice Catnipp
candice_catnipp.description: Sternritter 'T' - 'The Thunderbolt'. Hot-tempered member of the Bambies wielding devastating lightning strikes.

giselle_gewelle.name: Giselle Gewelle
giselle_gewelle.description: Sternritter 'Z' - 'The Zombie'. Enslaves living and deceased beings through her blood, converting them into zombies.

nanana_najahkoop.name: NaNaNa Najahkoop
nanana_najahkoop.description: Sternritter 'U' - 'The Underbelly'. Analyzes an opponent's reiatsu distribution over time to exploit critical weak points.

gremmy_thoumeaux.name: Gremmy Thoumeaux
gremmy_thoumeaux.description: Sternritter 'V' - 'The Visionary'. A disembodied brain whose imagination turns anything into physical reality.

nianzol_weizol.name: Nianzol Weizol
nianzol_weizol.description: Sternritter 'W' - 'The Wind'. Two-tongued Quincy whose instinct deflects all attacks away from him and Yhwach.

royd_lloyd.name: Royd Lloyd
royd_lloyd.description: Sternritter 'Y' - 'The Yourself' (elder twin). Copies an opponent's exact memories and personality; posed as Yhwach to stall Yamamoto.

loyd_lloyd.name: Loyd Lloyd
loyd_lloyd.description: Sternritter 'Y' - 'The Yourself' (younger twin). Copies an opponent's exact powers and physical appearance; fought Kenpachi Zaraki.

berenice_gabrielli.name: Berenice Gabrielli
berenice_gabrielli.description: Sternritter 'Q' - 'The Question'. Attempted to instill self-doubt in Kenpachi Zaraki before being swiftly slain.

jerome_guizbatt.name: Jerome Guizbatt
jerome_guizbatt.description: Sternritter 'R' - 'The Roar'. Ape-like beast Quincy who emitted sonic roars before being cut down by Kenpachi Zaraki.

guenael_lee.name: Guenael Lee
guenael_lee.description: Sternritter 'V' - 'The Vanishing Point'. Manifestation created by Gremmy capable of disappearing from sight and memory.

shaz_domino.name: Shaz Domino
shaz_domino.description: Sternritter capable of regeneration from surrounding reishi; confronted Ichigo Kurosaki upon his arrival in Seireitei.

asguiaro_ebern.name: Asguiaro Ebern
asguiaro_ebern.description: Arrancar conscripted into the Wandenreich who attempted to seal Ichigo Kurosaki's Bankai using a Quincy medallion.

luders_friegen.name: Luders Friegen
luders_friegen.description: Arrancar vanguard who declared war to Yamamoto in the First Division barracks on behalf of the Wandenreich.

chika_shihoin.name: Chika Shihōin
chika_shihoin.description: Original Captain of Squad 2 and ancestor of Yoruichi Shihōin. Master of Hakuda and covert assassination.

kinroku_izuhara.name: Kinroku Izuhara
kinroku_izuhara.description: Original Captain of Squad 3. Historical warrior who founded the 13 Court Guard Squads under Yamamoto.

chigiri_shijima.name: Chigiri Shijima
chigiri_shijima.description: Original Captain of Squad 4. Lethal, gaunt warrior of the ruthless first-generation Gotei 13.

danjiro_obana.name: Danjirō Obana
danjiro_obana.description: Original Captain of Squad 5. Towering, heavily-armored founding captain of the Gotei 13.

furofushi_saito.name: Furōfushi Saitō
furofushi_saito.description: Original Captain of Squad 6. Wild, twin-tailed outlaw swordswoman known for vicious combat.

nobutsuna_shigyo.name: Nobutsuna Shigyō
nobutsuna_shigyo.description: Original Captain of Squad 7. Fierce founding warrior of the original Gotei 13.

batsuunsai_katori.name: Batsu'unsai Katori
batsuunsai_katori.description: Original Captain of Squad 8. Bespectacled naginata wielder among the founding generation.

entetsu_kumoi.name: Entetsu Kumoi
entetsu_kumoi.description: Original Captain of Squad 9. Brutal, spiked-club wielder of the first generation.

furuoki_otogawa.name: Furuoki Ōtogawa
furuoki_otogawa.description: Original Captain of Squad 10. Founding Gotei 13 captain who stood alongside Yamamoto 1,000 years ago.

uhin_zenjoji.name: Uhin Zenjōji
uhin_zenjoji.description: Original Captain of Squad 12. Monkish brawler of the original generation of defenders.

saizo_sakahone.name: Saizō Sakahone
saizo_sakahone.description: Original Captain of Squad 13. Elder swordsman who served in the founding Gotei 13.

tokinada_tsunayashiro.name: Tokinada Tsunayashiro
tokinada_tsunayashiro.description: Head of the Tsunayashiro Clan and primary antagonist of CFYOW. Wielded the ancestral Zanpakutō Enrakyōten.

hikone_ubuginu.name: Hikone Ubuginu
hikone_ubuginu.description: Central protagonist of CFYOW. Artificial soul created by Tokinada, combining Shinigami, Quincy, Hollow, and Fullbringer souls.

aura_michibane.name: Aura Michibane
aura_michibane.description: Master Fullbringer in CFYOW capable of manipulating ambient matter with godlike finesse. Acted as Tokinada's lieutenant.

ikomikidomoe.name: Ikomikidomoe
ikomikidomoe.description: Ancient primordial Hollow defeated by Ichibei Hyōsube and sealed into the Zanpakutō wielded by Hikone.

soya_azashiro.name: Sōya Azashiro
soya_azashiro.description: The 8th Kenpachi. Main antagonist of SAFWY whose Bankai fused his spirit with all of Seireitei; imprisoned in the Muken.

kenpachi_kuruyashiki.name: Kenpachi Kuruyashiki
kenpachi_kuruyashiki.description: The legendary 7th Kenpachi. Beloved captain of Squad 11 with a catastrophic Bankai banned in Seireitei; defeated by Azashiro.

roka_paramia.name: Roka Paramia
roka_paramia.description: Arrancar medic from SAFWY. Former Fracción of Szayelaporro who manipulated Negación threads and bonded with Don Kan'onji.
